

# events

The client mounts the feed supplied by `data-src`. The feed endpoint supplies
rendered event HTML; the client updates countdowns and map links in that HTML.
The registry serves this coral through its versioned channel.

<!-- coral metadata: start (generated by catalog-readme.mjs) -->
## events metadata

Shows an event feed from a JSON endpoint and updates countdown labels in the browser.

Author: `official`.

### Embed

```html
<div data-dynamic-coral="events" data-src="/events.json"></div>
<script type="module" src="https://feelreef.com/corals/events/v0/events.js"></script>
```

### Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Required | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `data-dynamic-coral` | enum | yes | — | Selects this coral. |
| `data-src` | url | no | `/events.json` | JSON event feed URL. |
| `data-empty` | string | no | `No upcoming events.` | Text shown when the feed has no renderable HTML. |
| `data-in-prefix` | string | no | `in ` | Prefix for upcoming countdowns. |
| `data-live-label` | string | no | `Now` | Text for an event happening now. |
| `data-countdown` | enum | no | — | Set to always to show far-off countdowns. |

<!-- coral metadata: end -->
